distant03.label: NOT_USEFUL
distant03.rationale: Adjudicated NOT_USEFUL, siding with judge A. The reply is coherent and correct as far as it goes. It explains water vapour in the air, a window colder than the air beside it, and that air cooling to its dew point. Generation stops at the 256-token limit on 'Condensation (Initially): When the air reaches its dew point'. The reply never says the glass must be below freezing or that the vapour turns to ice, which is the step that makes frost rather than dew, so the central fact of the request is missing. Not broken, since the text is intelligible and has no loop. The judging workflow labelled the clean reference's reply, also cut off before the freezing step, NOT_USEFUL, and A3's similar cut-off USEFUL, so the earlier calls on this item disagree.

distant04.label: NOT_USEFUL
distant04.rationale: Adjudicated NOT_USEFUL, siding with judge A. The reply is coherent and correct as far as it goes. It gives 1 cup of rice to 2 cups of water, rinsing, combining in the pan and bringing to a rolling boil. Generation stops at the 256-token limit on 'immediately reduce the heat to'. It never gives the heat level, the simmer time or the sign that the rice is done, so a visitor cannot finish the method from it. That omits the requested usable steps. Not broken, since the text is intelligible and has no loop. The judging workflow also labelled the clean and A3 replies, cut at or before the same step, NOT_USEFUL.
